title: The module header has grown to ~89 lines of accreted narrative across CAM-358/C…
body: The module header has grown to ~89 lines of accreted narrative across CAM-358/CAM-359/CAM-364 (original model, round-1 correction, round-2 reader decoupling, now the prompt-row discriminator). Every paragraph is accurate and the residue disclosure is honest, but a future reader must reconstruct the current design from a changelog. Consider condensing to a short 'current design + not-closed residue' statement and relocating the superseded-model history to scripts/cam/patterns.md, which already carries the full write-up.

title: The fixture header still names MIN_PAYLOAD_TAIL_MATCH in its historical narrati…
body: The fixture header still names MIN_PAYLOAD_TAIL_MATCH in its historical narrative. This is intentional and correct (it explains why the removed backstop appeared to work against the wrong collision shape), and it is outside every oracle's scope, but it is the last textual reference to the removed symbol in the tree. Worth a glance if a future story greps repo-wide for the retired name.
